result.title: The Judge Can Debias Itself: Awareness and Self-Debiasing for Reliable LLM-as-a-Judge
result.summary: LLM-as-a-Judge systems are increasingly employed for automated evaluation, yet remain susceptible to systematic biases that undermine their reliability. We demonstrate that the judge can effectively debias itself without additional training. We propose two lightweight strategies: bias-aware prompting, which explicitly alerts the judge to potential target biases prior to evaluation, and self-debiasing, in which the judge critiques the initial judgment for bias influence. To broaden the evaluation scope, we introduce three novel benchmarks--authority bias (fabricated citations), confidence bias (assertive phrasing), and formatting bias (structured presentation)--and evaluate across seven bias types in total. Across three frontier models, self-debiasing improves performance in 20 out of 21 model-bias combinations with gains up to 15 percentage points, while bias-aware prompting also yields consistent improvements. The recent fine-tuned external critic, however, does not generalize as reliably to the newly-introduced bias types (degradation observed in 5 out of 9 cases). Our findings demonstrate that prompting a judge to reason about bias, either preemptively or retrospectively, is a robust and generalizable approach for enhancing evaluation integrity.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 LLM-as-a-Judge 的系统性偏差，提出免训练的「偏差感知提示」和「自我去偏」（让评判模型事后审查初始判断是否受偏差影响）两种策略，并新增权威、自信、格式三类偏差基准，在三个前沿模型、七类偏差上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其免训练的事后自我审查循环可能为推理期自验证、信念修正与停止决策提供可核查线索，同时评判偏差如何扭曲对 latent 推理增益的评价也值得留意。
